posts.name: Envisioner
posts.cooked:
I'm hoping that I can find at least one person on this forum who'd be up for playing a real-time PBP game of Sentinels with me, as I've been doing an unhealthy amount of solitaire in order to get my fix.  I say "real time" because I have only about a week before I'll be starting a new work gig, so the idea of a long, slow correspondence game where each player posts once or twice a day doesn't work for me; instead, I'd need someone to schedule a block of time to be online, and we'd exchange posts while maintaining the game across our respective copies of the game.

I'll be available from roughly 9AM to 9PM on Tuesday, Wednesday and probably Saturday, with part of that time on Monday (I'll be out shopping in the morning and perhaps early afternoon) to devote to scheduling, and about half a day each on Thursday (the afternoon to evening) and Friday (the morning to afternoon).  I do not own Rook City or Infernal Relics, but I have all the mini-expansions as well as Shattered Timelines; please select 1 or more heroes and a Villain that are available to me, so I can set the game up as we play for ease of tracking.  We will then take turns posting every 5 to 20 minutes, depending on flow (a longer silence, without some explanation, would suggest a person has ragequit and their position should be taken over).  I would love to have as many as five other players (if we wanted to do Freedom Six vs. Iron Legacy, as I haven't tried that game), but as I said before, i only need a minimum of 1, and that person may play only one hero if they prefer...I'd rather they take two heroes, since I'll be handling the Villain and Environment, but since I've done 4- and once even 5-player solitaire games, I can take the mandatory second hero if the other player isn't comfortable doing so.

So, anyone up for this?
